method: Full pinned file read; Git blob verified; AST counted 17 top-level test functions, not expanded pytest cases. Ran existing local overlapping-root regression. Upstream directory tests not executed.
findings: Directory tests cover nested merging, unequal counts, hardlinks, followed/ignored symlinks, zero-sized files under explicit types/size policies, tagged-root precedence and original flags. Bind-mount case explicitly requires root.

Layout tests distinguish default content-set semantics from explicit layout matching, including same filenames nested differently and swapped content under matching names. Several negative layout checks only iterate returned rows and assert duplicate_file type, so an empty result satisfies them.

Existing XOR-cancelling regression uses two copies of xxx versus two copies of yyy and checks two matching xxx directories plus internal yyy duplicates. This tests distinct hash-set protection, not the same-set/different-multiplicity counterexample from v52. No A,A,A,B versus A,B,B,B fixture exists in this file.

filter_part_of_directory deliberately removes directory-member detail records before assertions, so these tests do not validate complete member associations through this helper. Some tagged-root tests only assert at least two result rows and selected leading paths.

pedantic_options starts with paranoid and, outside pedantic environment, adds every configured checksum type. This expands source-level intended coverage but is not evidence of executed algorithm combinations.

local_verification.scope: 192 authored files, 48 exact three-member partitions, repeated/overlapping nested roots in forward/reverse order, limited traversal and cancellation/retry. File grouping only; no directory-equivalence API claim.

limits: No full upstream scanner reproduction of multiplicity issue.
